title: Towards Auditing Large Language Models: Improving Text-based Stereotype Detection
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'Religion' as one of the four primary societal dimensions evaluated for stereotypic bias. It introduces the Multi-Grain Stereotype (MGS) dataset containing religious stereotypes and performs detailed benchmarking and SHAP analysis on religious stereotypic text generated by LLMs like GPT-4, providing specific results and examples for religious categories (e.g., Islam, Hinduism).
